target.role: repair tail-only evaluation bias by reassessing known PARKED identities across the full non-protected STRANGE GAIT journey
target.position: Whole journey. Preserve Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal handoffs; Truth in Noise → Transparency and all other non-frozen boundaries remain available.
target.purpose: Reassess exact identities from Run 50 whose earlier verdicts inherited a post-Stardancer slot. Test stronger current placements across the whole journey.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

proposedPlacements.purpose: Test whether its source-described polyrhythmic percussion deepens the existing tilt passage before Tehutis Law re-grounds the groove.

evidence.attributedDescription: The Third Room attributes percussion at the centre, polyrhythmic bleeps, restraint and persistent drive to Shark Attak.
